tutorial.queens: **The eight queens never enter play.** The game is named for the Salic Law barring female succession; the removed queens sit aside as decoration. You play with the remaining 96 cards.
tutorial.foundation: There are eight foundations. Start one on an ace and build up to a jack **ignoring suit** (11 cards -- queens are out of play and kings stay put). All 8 x 11 = 88 cards wins. A foundation cannot be used until its column has been opened.
tutorial.tableau: Each column is based on a king. **Dealing puts one card on the current column, and a king opens the next one.** There is no waste: a dealt card lands on top of its column, so you can move it straight away.
tutorial.bareKing: **Columns do not build on each other.** The one exception is a column holding just its king, which will take any single card. The base king itself never moves.
tutorial.controls: Buttons for dealing, hints, undo and auto-complete.

hintReason.toFoundation: Sending this card to a foundation frees up its column
hintReason.toTableau: Park it on the bare king to dig out the card beneath
hintReason.draw: Nothing can move -- deal another card to open up a play
